featureHints.commit_message: Writes a draft from the staged changes.
featureHints.pr_description: Writes title and description from the commits of a branch.
featureHints.compose: Proposes how to split the changes into commits.
featureHints.conflict_intent: Explains what both sides of a conflict wanted.
featureHints.push_review: Looks for leftovers before you push.
featureHints.plan: Turns a sentence in the command palette into Forkyard steps.
featureHints.archaeology: Summarises the history of a line.
featureHints.release_notes: Groups the commits since the last tag.
featureHints.bisect_script: Writes a test script for bisect.
featureHints.semantic_search: Finds commits by what they are about.
featureHints.review_fix: Proposes fixes for open review comments.
featureHints.stack_split: Proposes where to cut a branch into pull requests that build on each other.

settings.title: AI
settings.intro: Commit messages, pull request texts and more with a provider of your choice. Off until you turn it on; one provider and one key for every profile.

master.title: AI features
master.description: Turns every AI function on or off. Turning it off cancels running requests at once.
master.unset: Not set up yet. “Set up …” finds the AI tools on this computer – or choose a provider below and turn this on.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Who answers the requests. Local models run on this computer, and nothing leaves it.

baseUrl.title: Address
baseUrl.description: Address of the service including the version, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Unencrypted http:// only to this computer.
baseUrl.descriptionLocal: Leave empty for the standard port on this computer.

key.title: API key
key.description: Stored only in the operating system’s keychain; Forkyard shows at most the last four characters. “Check” saves it.

check.title: Connection
check.description: Asks the provider for its models – with the key entered above, if there is one.

model.title: Model
model.description: Check the connection to choose from the provider’s models, or enter the model ID.

price.title: Price
price.known: {{input}} USD per million input tokens, {{output}} USD per million output tokens (price list of {{asOf}})
price.own: Own price: {{input}} / {{output}} USD per million tokens
price.unknown: Price unknown – no cost estimate and no protection by the monthly limit. You can enter your own price below.
price.local: Runs on this computer – no costs.

ownPrice.title: Own price
ownPrice.description: USD per million tokens as “input / output”, e.g. 2 / 10. Empty = the price list.

exclude.title: Never send
exclude.description: Patterns in .gitignore syntax, one per line, for every repository. A repository can add its own in .forkyard/ai-ignore. Secrets, .env files and keys are never sent anyway.

whatIsSent.title: What is sent?
whatIsSent.description: Shows the exact text for the staged changes of the open repository – without sending anything.
whatIsSent.noRepo: Open a repository to see an example.

costThreshold.title: Ask above
costThreshold.description: Ask before a request whose estimated cost is higher than this (USD).

askAgain.title: Confirmations
askAgain.description: Forkyard asks before the first use of a function, before more than 100,000 characters, above the amount above, and before a provider gets content of a repository for the first time.

limit.title: Monthly limit
limit.description: Ask before every further request once this month’s estimated costs reach this amount (USD). Empty = no limit. Only for API providers with a known price.

settings.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in USD, e.g. 0.10.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: Finds Claude Code, Codex, opencode, local models and stored keys on this computer and turns AI on in a few steps. Nothing is sent.

cliPath.description: Own path to the program. Empty = found automatically (PATH, the usual install folders, the login shell’s PATH).

settings.opencodeNote: opencode stores its sessions on this computer.
settings.cliPrice: Billed through {{name}}: Forkyard estimates no costs, and the monthly limit does not apply. Usage is counted when the tool reports it.
settings.signInNoRepo: Open a repository to sign in in its terminal, or run the sign-in command in a terminal of your own.

off.title: AI off for this repository
off.description: No AI element appears for this repository, and nothing of it is sent.

commitInstruction.title: Own commit instruction
commitInstruction.description: Goes along with every commit-message request for this repository, e.g. “End the summary with the ticket key.” At most 2,000 characters.
commitInstruction.placeholder: e.g. Use English and the prefixes feat:, fix:, docs:

preview.title: What is sent?
preview.lookIntro: Exactly this text would go to the provider. Nothing was sent.
preview.confirmIntro: Please confirm before this goes to the provider.
preview.shortened: Shortened to the start and end of each hunk: {{files}}

ask.firstUse: This function sends content to the provider for the first time.
ask.repoFirst: The provider gets content of this repository for the first time.
ask.limit: This month’s costs ({{spent}}) have reached the limit ({{limit}}). Send this request anyway?

reason.secret: looks like a secret – never sent
reason.ignored: excluded by a pattern – never sent
reason.generated: generated or lock file – only name and size
reason.binary: binary file – only name and size
reason.budget: too large – only name and line counts

embedder.title: Embeddings for the search
embedder.description: A provider on this computer can serve the search alone. Otherwise the main provider’s embeddings are used; without embeddings the main provider rephrases the question into a search.

model.title: Embedding model
model.description: Empty: the main provider’s default, if it has one.

index.title: Index of this repository
index.noRepo: Open a repository to see its index.
index.none: No index yet – it is built on the first search by meaning.
index.rephrase: No index: without embeddings the question is rephrased into a search.

delete.title: Delete index
delete.description: Removes the index of every repository and model. The next search by meaning builds it again.
delete.confirmTitle: Delete the search index of every repository?
delete.confirmBody: The index only serves the search by meaning; nothing in your repositories changes. This cannot be undone – the next search by meaning builds it again and sends the commit texts to the embedding provider once more.

entry.label: Set up AI features
entry.tooltip: Commit messages, PR texts and more with an AI provider of your choice. Off by default.

intro.title: New in 1.2: AI features and coding agents – off by default.

setup.title: Set up AI
setup.intro: Forkyard looks for AI tools on this computer. Nothing is sent while setting up.
setup.none: No AI tool, local model or stored key was found.

cli.envKey: Uses the API key from the environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) instead of the sign-in.

local.noModels: Running at {{address}} – no model installed yet

nothing.title: How do you want to use AI?
nothing.localHint: Ollama runs models on this computer; nothing leaves it.
nothing.cockpitHint: Coding agents work without an AI provider. AI can be turned on later in Settings › AI.

model.title: Model
model.cliHint: Leave empty to use the tool’s default model.

features.hint: Every function can be switched off later in Settings › AI.

done.noRepo: Open a repository to see an example of what is sent.

where.cli: Requests go to {{name}} on this computer, which passes them to its provider with your sign-in. Forkyard stores nothing of it.
where.api: Requests go over the internet to {{name}}, with the key from your keychain.

command.keywords: AI, KI, LLM, model, Claude, Codex, Ollama, provider
